findings.evidence: Lines 99-100. `associated_prod` is `@[simp]` at Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm/Prod.lean:224; `associated_left_inverse` at Basic.lean:906; `isSymm_dualProd` at Dual.lean:43; `LinearMap.dualProd.toQuadraticForm` at Dual.lean:98.
findings.fix: Make the final step terminal instead of rewriting into `ring_nf` output: establish the cancellation first (`have h2 : (2 : K) * ⅟(2 : K) = 1 := mul_invOf_self 2`) and close with `linear_combination`, or drop the hand computation entirely and derive the closed form from `QuadraticMap.associated_prod` plus `QuadraticMap.associated_left_inverse` applied to `LinearMap.isSymm_dualProd` (via `LinearMap.dualProd.toQuadraticForm`).
findings.issue: `ring_nf` is followed by `rw [mul_comm (⅟(2 : K)) (∑ i, x.2 i * y.2 i), invOf_mul_cancel_right]`. `⅟(2 : K)` is an opaque atom to `ring_nf`, so this rewrite depends on the exact atom ordering and parenthesisation `ring_nf` happens to emit; any change to `ring_nf`'s normalisation breaks the proof with a `motive`/`did not find instance` error, and the reader cannot see why the cancellation applies.

findings.evidence: Lines 124-134 (the local `have hsum`), consumed only at line 136; `hyperbolicRemainder` is a public `abbrev` (line 45) and appears in the `@[simp]` statement at line 61.
findings.fix: Extract it as a named lemma next to `hyperbolicRemainder`, e.g. `theorem sum_hyperbolicRemainder (w : hyperbolicRemainder K n) (i) : ∑ j, w j = w i`, or supply `instance : Subsingleton (Fin (n % 2))`, and prove it with `Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (Finset.mem_univ i) fun j _ hji => absurd (Fin.ext (by omega)) hji` rather than the `exfalso`/`apply` chain.
findings.issue: `hsum` reproves inline, with `exfalso`/`Fin.ext`/`isLt`/`Nat.mod_lt`/`omega` plumbing, that `Fin (n % 2)` is a subsingleton so sums over it collapse. This is a reusable fact about the public `hyperbolicRemainder K n`, and `hyperbolicModelForm_apply` (a `@[simp]` lemma) exposes `∑ i, x.2 i * x.2 i` over exactly that index type, so every downstream consumer will need it and will re-derive it the same way.

findings.fix: Use `simp only` with the lemmas actually needed (the prod/pi finrank lemmas and `Subspace.dual_finrank_eq`, e.g. `Module.finrank_pi`, `Fintype.card_fin`) so `omega` receives a stable `n / 2 + n / 2 + n % 2 = n` goal.
findings.issue: Non-terminal `simp` feeding `omega`: `omega` sees whatever arithmetic goal the full default simp set happens to leave, so a change to any unrelated simp lemma silently changes the goal and breaks the proof. `Subspace.dual_finrank_eq` is also redundant in the simp set since it is already `@[simp]`.

summary: The associated-form computation ends by rewriting into `ring_nf`'s normal form, which is the classic brittle pattern; the separating-left proof buries a reusable subsingleton fact about the remainder index and reproves it with manual `Fin` plumbing; `finrank_hyperbolicModel` feeds a non-terminal `simp` into `omega`.
